Making it easier for more Americans to exercise the right to vote is something every public servant should be able to get behind. 

Reforms like:
🗳️ Creating automatic voter registration
🚌 Making Election Day a federal holiday, &
⚖️ Ending partisan gerrymandering (2/2)

Peeps (my family’s rescue cat) is happy to hear that I received a 100% on the Humane Society’s Scorecard this year!

I’m committed to serve as a voice for the humane treatment of our animal friends & will continue to #VoteHumane to improve federal protections for animals. https://t.co/ncX8sogLCP

Right now, Californians can pay over $300 per vial for their insulin.

Today, I’m voting for the #AffordableInsulinNow Act to cap the cost for insulin at no more than $35/per month to help millions afford the lifesaving treatment that they need. https://t.co/PvITIVkVK0

The Central Coast knows the value of water, especially with unprecedented drought.

I've delivered $112,000+ for the Santa Ynez Band of Chumash Indians Wastewater Treatment Plant - this will increase cooperation with water resources and help maintain conversation goals. https://t.co/lgsxJNlwMK

During my time in Congress, I've fought to address food insecurity, including hosting last year's Central Coast Hunger Tour w/ @RepMcGovern.

I'm glad that @POTUS will hold this historic conference on hunger & nutrition, so we can find transformational solutions to #endhunger.

The wellness of Central Coast students is a huge priority of mine.

That's why I met with school board members from Ventura & Santa Barbara to discuss how we can expand access to all educational programs, & the importance of caring for our students' physical & mental health. https://t.co/BrL70rPmYS

Great to reopen the newly-restored LeRoy Park for the families of Guadalupe!  With the $1.7 million I delivered, the City of Guadalupe will be able to add to these renovations with additional barbeque pits, exercise facilities, and a brand new amphitheater. https://t.co/GGFqyXSWw9

The #RestoringHope for Mental Health and Well-Being Act strengthens more than 30 programs that support mental health care and substance use disorder prevention, care, treatment, and recovery support services on the Central Coast. I'm proud to vote YES on this legislation today. https://t.co/GzdpVoJmx6

I'm pushing @HHSgov to get more vaccines and resources in place to help stop the spread of Monkeypox in California.

Get more information on its symptoms, treatments, and prevention strategies here: https://t.co/xvLwn2ghBa

https://t.co/Fp8BN9u7Bd

This #HungerActionMonth, let's talk about the issue of food insecurity.   Check out the video below, where @RepMcGovern, my colleague on @HouseAgDems Nutrition Subcommittee, and I discuss how many Americans struggle to put food on the table everyday 👇🏼 
https://t.co/eq5mABWEiM

Proud to represent the Central Coast at the first @WhiteHouse Conference on Hunger, Nutrition, & Health in 50 years!

Thank you @POTUS for your leadership in convening experts & advocates from across the nation to ensure no American goes hungry. #WHConfHungerHealth https://t.co/jaAOeHPqm7

@POTUS @RepJimmyPanetta I will continue to utilize every resource I have to get the Central Coast the support we need to keep individuals safe and minimize the damage to our environment.

Please continue to exercise vigilance, and stay aware of emergency alerts.

In the last year, nearly 40% of Americans put off medical treatment because they couldn't pay for it.

While @HouseDemocrats are working to make health care more affordable, MAGA Republicans want to cut Social Security & Medicare benefits for thousands of Central Coast seniors.

The Biden-Harris Administration is the first ever to propose a national drinking water standard for 'forever chemicals.'  PFAS are a danger to our children & our communities, & I will keep working to ensure everyone has access to clean drinking water.  https://t.co/nf29CIAbWP

Parks and green spaces are essential to the quality of life in every community.

Proud to have successfully fought to deliver $1.2 million to @CityOfLompoc to fund renovations at Pioneer Park, including new baseball fields and exercise area.

Learn more: https://t.co/2YkdxFpw08 https://t.co/2KCfeSZMO5

@SecVetAffairs My team and I had been liaising between Legacy Village and the VA since the spring to keep this treatment available to local veterans.

I made it clear to @SecVetAffairs: I want VA policies changed to ensure a veteran in need doesn't face hurdles like a long commute or wait time.

@SBCPublicHealth I helped pass legislation that’s saving Central Coast residents $1,100/year on ACA premiums.

There’s more to be done to ensure all Americans have access to affordable health care–but thanks to @HouseDemocrats, we’re seeing record-low uninsured rates and more signed up than ever!

This week on Salud Street: health insurance! 🎶

Did you know? 👉 4 out of 5 Americans found coverage on the insurance marketplace for $10/month or less this year. https://t.co/AVqRCnt3SG

For uninterrupted coverage starting January 1st, you must enroll by this Friday, December 15th!

Enroll today @ https://t.co/F2ZXrkcnP5!

🩺 Central Coast: don’t forget — you have until January 31st to sign up for health care coverage through @CoveredCa. 

Millions of Americans found a health care plan for <$10/month this year, and you could be next! ⤵️
https://t.co/9dirR6zz67

Had a thoughtful discussion w/ nurses from the National Black Nurses Association about how we can solve the inequities of America’s health care system & deliver affordable care to all.

These nurses are heroes — and I’m committed to supporting them & patients' needs in Congress! https://t.co/VuQB2zFeQI

I told Ava & her Mother Vanessa that I'm committed to investing more in pediatric cancer research, lowering treatment costs, and finally achieving not just a cure for cancer, but also a health care system that puts no family in financial peril just for seeking the care they need. https://t.co/WTLXeKDchQ

I know firsthand the difference federal nutrition programs make in a family’s life – which is why I was proud to help deliver full funding for WIC in the deal signed by @POTUS earlier this month.

This program ensures mothers & children have access to the resources they need! https://t.co/jQmRZw6Go3

Over 600 people on the Central Coast rely on life-saving dialysis treatment from the @DaVita San Luis Obispo Clinic.

I had the opportunity to meet some of their phenomenal medical professionals and get a glimpse into the vital work they do for our community. 🥼🩺 https://t.co/fvYNtxrwOc

@HouseDemocrats are committed to lowering costs for hardworking American taxpayers. 

That’s why we made history by:

💉capping the price of insulin at $35/month for seniors
💊lowering the costs of prescription drugs
🏥reducing health insurance premiums for millions of Americans!
